camel_example: aliyun live DescribeLiveDomainTrafficData --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn alibaba --EndTime '2017-12-10T15:00:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --LocationNameEn tianjin --StartTime '2017-12-10T14:00:00Z' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Interval 300
description_en: Queries network traffic monitoring data for live streaming domains
description_zh: 查询直播域名网络流量监控数据
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-live-domain-traffic-data --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --start-time 2017-12-10T14:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-10T15:00:00Z --interval 300 --isp-name-en alibaba --location-name-en tianjin --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLiveDomainTrafficData

parameters.help_en:
The streaming domain. You can specify a single domain name or multiple domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). If this parameter is left empty, the merged data of all live streaming domains is returned by default.
When you specify DomainName, make sure that the specified domain names are live streaming domains and that you have the required permissions to operate on the specified domain names
parameters.help_zh:
播流域名。支持单个或批量域名查询。批量查询时多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔。若参数为空，默认返回所有直播域名合并后的数据。
传入DomainName时，请保证传入域名为直播域名，同时调用本接口的用户拥有传入域名的操作权限
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format in UTC. You can query data from the past 90 days
parameters.help_zh: 起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 支持查询最近90天的数据
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。需晚于起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity for querying data. Unit: seconds. Valid values:
300 (default).
3600.
86400.

If you do not set this parameter or set it to an unsupported value, the default value 300 seconds is used
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据的时间粒度。单位：秒。取值：
300（默认值）。
3600。
86400。

不传或传值不支持时，使用默认值300秒
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The name of the Internet service provider (ISP) in English. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to obtain the ISP name. If you do not set this parameter, data of all ISPs is returned
parameters.help_zh: 运营商英文名。通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html获得，不传为所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en: The name of the region in English. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to obtain the region name. If you do not set this parameter, data of all regions is returned
parameters.help_zh: 区域英文名。通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html获得，不传为所有区域
parameters.name: location_name_en

DataInterval.description_en: The time granularity for querying data

StartTime.description_en: The start time. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format in UTC

DataModule.description_en: The traffic data for each time interval
DataModule.description_zh: 每个时间间隔的流量数据

items.description_en: The traffic data for each time interval
items.description_zh: 每个时间间隔的流量数据

TimeStamp.description_en: The start time of the time interval. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format in UTC
TimeStamp.description_zh: 时间片起始时刻。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC 时间）
